mapper.sql: select id, tenant_code, product_seq, process_seq, pass_num, ng_num, created_by, created_date, last_upd_by, last_upd_date from micro_process_storage
mapper.select: select d.product_code productCode, d.product_name productName, p.process_code processCode, p.process_name processName, s.pass_num passNum, s.ng_num ngNum from micro_process_storage s left join micro_process_common p on s.tenant_code = p.tenant_code and s.process_seq = p.process_seq left join micro_product d on s.tenant_code = d.tenant_code and s.product_seq = d.product_seq order by s.last_upd_date desc

SELECT mps.product_seq, mp.product_name, mp.product_code, ifnull(sum(pass_num),0) as pass_num, ifnull(sum(ng_num), 0) as ng_num, mp.unit as product_unit FROM micro_process_storage mps LEFT JOIN micro_product mp on mps.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mps.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code
and mp.product_seq = #{productSeq}
and ( mp.product_code like concat('%',#{productNameOrCode},'%') or mp.product_name like concat('%',#{productNameOrCode},'%') )
GROUP BY product_seq ORDER BY ifnull(sum(pass_num),0) + ifnull(sum(ng_num), 0) desc
mapper.insert:
insert into micro_process_storage
tenant_code, product_seq, process_seq, pass_num, ng_num, created_by,
#{tenantCode}, #{productSeq}, #{processSeq}, #{passNum}, #{ngNum}, #{createdBy},
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_upd_by = #{lastUpdBy} , pass_num = #{passNum} , ng_num = #{ngNum}

insert into micro_process_storage (tenant_code, process_seq, product_seq, pass_num, ng_num, created_by, created_date, last_upd_by, last_upd_date) values
(#{item.tenantCode}, #{item.processSeq}, #{item.productSeq}, #{item.passNum}, #{item.ngNum}, #{item.createdBy}, #{item.createdDate}, #{item.lastUpdBy}, #{item.lastUpdDate})

mapper.select: SELECT concat(mws.product_seq, '_', mws.operate_process_seq) AS SEQ_KEY, round(ifnull(sum(mws.pass_num) / (sum(mws.pass_num) + sum(mws.ng_num)), 0), 4) AS PASS_RATE, (sum(mws.pass_num) + sum(mws.ng_num)) / count(DISTINCT mws.submit_day) AS AVG_PRODUCTION_CAPACITY FROM micro_work_submit mws WHERE mws.submit_status = 0 and mws.submit_type = '1' and mws.submit_day <= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) group by mws.product_seq, mws.operate_process_seq

SELECT mps.id, mps.tenant_code, mps.product_seq, mpc.process_code, mpc.process_name, mps.process_seq, mp.product_code, mp.product_name, mp.unit as product_unit, mps.pass_num, mps.ng_num, mu.nick_name AS created_by, mps.created_date FROM micro_process_storage mps LEFT JOIN micro_product mp ON mp.tenant_code = mps.tenant_code AND mps.product_seq = mp.product_seq LEFT JOIN micro_process_common mpc ON mps.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code AND mps.process_seq = mpc.process_seq LEFT JOIN micro_user mu ON mps.tenant_code = mu.tenant_code AND mps.created_by = mu.id WHERE mps.pass_num < 0

SELECT mps.id, mps.tenant_code, mps.product_seq, mpc.process_code, mpc.process_name, mps.process_seq, mp.product_code, mp.product_name, mp.unit as product_unit, mps.pass_num, mps.ng_num, mu.nick_name AS created_by, mps.created_date FROM micro_process_storage mps LEFT JOIN micro_product mp ON mp.tenant_code = mps.tenant_code AND mps.product_seq = mp.product_seq LEFT JOIN micro_process_common mpc ON mps.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code AND mps.process_seq = mpc.process_seq LEFT JOIN micro_user mu ON mps.tenant_code = mu.tenant_code AND mps.created_by = mu.id WHERE
mps.pass_num > 0 AND mps.ng_num > 0 AND mps.ng_num * 2 > mps.pass_num
SELECT concat(mps.product_seq, '_', mps.process_seq) AS seqKey, mps.pass_num as passNum, mps.ng_num as ngNum FROM micro_process_storage mps GROUP BY mps.product_seq, mps.process_seq

SELECT count(m.id) AS total, sum(IF(t.id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) AS ngNum FROM micro_process_storage m LEFT JOIN (SELECT id FROM micro_process_storage mps WHERE mps.pass_num > 0 AND mps.ng_num > 0 AND mps.ng_num * 2 > mps.pass_num UNION SELECT id FROM micro_process_storage mps WHERE mps.pass_num < 0
) AS t ON m.id = t.id
